metadata.title: Email Collaboration Relay

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for using email as a trusted relay in collaborative and workflow-driven processes requiring clear authority and integrity.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Workflow and collaboration systems that use email for approvals, task notifications, and inter-system coordination.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing the use of email as an authoritative relay in collaborative workflows.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Email collaboration relay assumes baseline delivery assurance, identity binding, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Email Collaboration Relay defines trust properties required to safely use email as a control and coordination channel in collaborative workflows. This pattern addresses authority confusion, workflow manipulation, and integrity risks when email messages are treated as implicit approvals or task triggers.

components.title: Workflow Authority Assertion
components.description: Ensures that email messages used in workflows reflect explicit and authorized decision-making authority.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Phishing or deceptive email content used to induce unauthorized actions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of legitimate accounts to manipulate workflow outcomes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Binding authorization decisions to authenticated and verified identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Workflow actions communicated by email are attributable to authenticated identities.
Email-driven workflow authority is limited to least privilege roles.

components.title: Email Workflow Integrity
components.description: Protects email messages used in workflows from unauthorized modification, replay, or misuse.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of stored or in-transit workflow communications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity checks to ensure workflow content is not altered.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms protect email messages that influence workflow decisions.
Routing and handling of workflow-related email preserves message correctness.

components.title: Email Workflow Auditability
components.description: Ensures email-based workflow actions are traceable and reviewable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to workflow decisions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email events relevant to workflow execution are logged.
Review of audit records supports detection of workflow misuse.
